cookies.title: Your privacy choices
cookies.description: We use essential storage to make Latvia Weather work. With your permission, we also use anonymous analytics and performance measurement.
cookies.necessaryDescription: Always on. These remember your forecast preferences, dismissed warnings and consent choice, and help protect the weather assistant from abuse.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Optional. Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights help us understand aggregated page use and site performance.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.serviceBody: Latvia Weather provides weather forecasts, maps, warnings and an optional weather assistant for information purposes. The service is operated by Kristaps Grinbergs in Latvia.
terms.useBody: You may use the service for personal, lawful purposes. Do not interfere with the service, attempt unauthorised access, scrape it at a harmful rate, or use it in a way that breaches applicable law or third-party rights.
terms.weatherBody: Forecasts and warnings can change and may be incomplete or delayed. Do not rely on the service as the sole source for safety-critical, emergency, aviation, marine, medical, or commercial decisions. Follow official instructions from competent authorities.
terms.rightsBody: The service and its design are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. Weather and warning data remain subject to their respective providers’ terms. You may not copy, republish or commercially exploit the service except where permitted by law or with permission.
terms.liabilityBody: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the maximum extent allowed by law, we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation and are not liable for indirect loss arising from use of, or inability to use, the service. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

privacy.title: Privacy & Cookie Notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how Latvia Weather handles personal data on the website and companion iOS app.
privacy.controllerBody: The controller is Kristaps Grinbergs, Latvia. You can contact the controller through kristaps.me. If you are in the EEA, you may also complain to your local data-protection authority.
privacy.dataBody: We process the forecast location you choose and technical request information such as IP address and device/browser data needed to deliver and secure the service. If you choose device location, it is used to find a nearby forecast location; it is not stored by the service. Messages sent to the weather assistant are processed to answer your request. We do not require accounts.
privacy.purposeBody: We use this information to provide forecast features, prevent abuse, maintain security and respond to requests. These processing activities are necessary for the service and our legitimate interests in operating it securely. Where we use optional analytics, the legal basis is your consent; you can withdraw it at any time below.
privacy.cookiesBody: Essential cookies store your selected location (up to 1 year), wind-unit preference (up to 1 year), dismissed weather warnings (14 days), consent choice (180 days), and a pseudonymous chat rate-limit identifier (up to 1 year). Local storage may retain your colour theme and weather-assistant chat history on your device. These are used only for requested functionality, security or remembering choices.
privacy.analyticsBody: Only when you opt in, we load Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights to measure aggregated use and performance. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. You can change or withdraw this choice at any time using Cookie settings below; disabling analytics does not affect core weather features.
privacy.retentionBody: Cookies remain for the periods stated above unless you delete them sooner. Local data remains on your device until you clear it. Service providers process data only to operate the service, including hosting, analytics when enabled, weather data and the optional AI assistant. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.rightsBody: Subject to applicable law, you can request access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection, or portability of personal data, and withdraw consent at any time. Contact us through kristaps.me. You may also delete cookies and local storage in your browser or device settings.
privacy.changesBody: We will publish updates here and change the “Last updated” date. If our data practices change materially, we will request consent again where required.
